prompt: Eye-level medium shot on a normal lens, from the bank steps at night, tall open brass doors filling the background, polished and burning with reflections. A round alarm lamp above them flashes hard red with white sparking at its core. Two men run toward us, one a stride ahead, each hauling a heavy canvas sack with no markings in a gloved hand. One is big and barrel-chested, the other thin and long-legged. Long dark coats, collars up. Each whole head is in a hand-knitted cream wool balaclava with no eye holes and no mouth hole, a thin black ring stitched around the face, and high inside it, over one eye's place, near the ring's edge, one small solid red felt triangle with rounded corners. Thanks.
